book: Montana Secretary of State: 2020 General Election, Precinct by Precinct Results
canvass: Montana Board of State Canvassers: 2020 Statewide General Election Canvass

notes: Listed on the Secretary's 'Official Election Results' page (https://sosmt.gov/elections/results/); the workbook's own title reads '2020 General Election Precinct by Precinct Results'. Read by its column headings (county, hd, name, party, precinct, race, sd, votes); one row a candidate a precinct. Its county sums are checked against the State Canvass for every contest the canvass carries. sosmt.gov refuses scripts since October 2026; this copy was saved before that.

The certified State Canvass: a table a contest, a row a county and a Total row, for the federal and statewide contests, the Public Service Commission, the courts and the statewide questions; its first page gives each county's number of precincts. Listed on the Secretary's results page.
gaps: not on disk (sosmt.gov refuses scripts): the State Senate and House contests rest on the precinct workbook alone, with no certified total to control them
The Secretary's precinct workbook carries no write-in votes; the Board canvasses declared write-ins on a separate abstract, which is not on disk. No figure here includes them.
a control for county offices and local questions
No county canvass is on disk and the State Canvass does not carry these contests, so they rest on the precinct workbook alone (checked only for being whole).
c: JOSEPH R. BIDEN AND KAMALA D. HARRIS
